label: Investment savings account (ISK)
Ange giltiga inställningar för svensk sk: Enter valid settings for Swedish tax after emigration.
Bekräftad avtalsbegränsning undantar vär: Confirmed treaty restriction exempts securities gains from Swedish tax
Sverige 2025: schablonbeskattning med kv: Sweden 2025: standard taxation uses quarterly values and deposits. The SEK 150,000 allowance is shared per person across ISK, capital insurance and PEPP; it does not apply separately to each account.
The default national rate is 30%. Tax treaties can reduce Swedish dividend tax.
